info.name: LegalSynq Liens — Legacy API
info.description:
All legacy route aliases for the LegalSynq Liens service.

**Auth**: Every request inherits the collection-level Bearer token.
Obtain a JWT from your Identity service with the required `permissions` claims (e.g. `SYNQ_LIENS.lien:read`, `SYNQ_LIENS.lien:service`, etc.) and paste it into the `bearerToken` environment variable.

**Environment**: Import `liens-legacy.postman_environment.json` alongside this collection.
The seed GUIDs match the test `SeedHelper` stable IDs so local dev runs work out of the box.

item.name: Report
item.description:
DIY (dynamic) report configuration, execution, and export.
Required permissions: `SYNQ_LIENS.case:read` (reads/runs), `SYNQ_LIENS.case:update` (delete)

request.description:
Returns all saved DIY report configurations for the current tenant/user.

Executes a DIY report with a given config and pagination.
Response: paginated `{ items, page, pageSize, totalCount }`
Permission: `SYNQ_LIENS.case:read`

Exports the DIY report result as a base64-encoded CSV.
Response: `{ "data": "<base64-csv>" }`

Saves a named DIY report configuration. Returns 201 Created with the saved config record.
Permission: `SYNQ_LIENS.case:read`

Response: `{ "isSuccess": true, "message": "..." }`
Permission: `SYNQ_LIENS.case:update`
